topic.title: Thermal Conditions for Single Core Turbo Enablement

body.p: Sensor Temperature Threshold: Processor frequency is dependent on sensor temperature. Exceeding thermal limits may restrict performance as referenced in section 2.1.

Impact of Ambient and Workload Variability: Elevated ambient temperatures or workloads with distinct thermal profiles may cause the sensor temperature to exceed the thermal threshold, thereby limiting the processor from reaching its maximum frequency.
